patterns.note: Asymmetrical two-column content blocks are frequently used, pairing large, full-bleed imagery or solid color fields with concise text on the opposing side, creating a dynamic, editorial feel.
Headings use a modern, bold sans-serif with generous letter-spacing, creating strong visual impact, often complemented by smaller, uppercase labels for categories or sub-sections.

A high-contrast monochrome base of dark greys, black, and white is consistently used for backgrounds and text, with vibrant, often saturated, accent colors introduced primarily through aspirational photography.
The hero section features a subtle parallax effect where the background image scrolls at a slower rate than the foreground content, creating a sense of depth as the user scrolls down.
The main navigation bar dynamically transforms from a transparent, dark overlay with white text to an opaque, light background with dark text once the user scrolls past the initial hero section.

technique_notes: Parallax scrolling for hero sections is achieved by moving the background image at a different speed than the foreground content, enhancing visual depth.
The global navigation bar uses a scroll-triggered state change, altering its background color and text color to maintain optimal contrast against varying page content.
Product and content galleries are implemented using horizontal carousels (swiper) that allow users to browse multiple items or images without navigating away from the current section.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold sans-serif headings (up to ~4-5x body text) with generous letter spacing, contrasted with smaller, regular-weight body text and often uppercase, tightly-spaced labels.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp. Elements like buttons and cards have minimal to no corner rounding.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced. Ample whitespace around major sections and content blocks, creating a clean and uncluttered feel, while text within blocks is well-spaced for readability.

standout: The site masterfully blends high-performance product presentation with an aspirational, editorial brand story, using full-bleed, dynamic photography and asymmetrical layouts to create a visually rich, magazine-like experience that feels premium and authentic. Its distinctive use of photography as a primary design element, rather than just decoration, sets it apart.
